# Auth Token: Request a Tenant Scoped Bearer Token

Area overview and notes: [auth-token.md](../auth-token.md)

`POST /oauth/token` · no token

Take this action to request a tenant scoped bearer token. Once you receive a tenant scoped bearer token, it is valid for 24 hours.

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `client_id` | string | Yes | Your Taxbit authentication client_id. |
| `client_secret` | string | Yes | Your Taxbit authentication client_secret. |
| `grant_type` | string | Yes | OAuth 2.0 grant_type. The only supported value at this time is client_credentials. |
| `tenant_id` | string | No | The tenant ID for which the authentication token is requested. Required when using consolidated credentials across multiple tenants. |

Example request body:

```json
{"client_id":"123456789abcdefgHiJKLMnopqrstuvw","client_secret":"987654321_abc-def-ijk","grant_type":"client_credentials","tenant_id":"e21d0001-8b50-4f6b-96de-15da392fdd6e"}
```

**Response 200**: Successful Tenant Scoped Auth Token Response

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `access_token` | string | Yes | Bearer token for further access to the API. |
| `expires_in` | integer | Yes | Time until token expires (in seconds). |
| `token_type` | string | Yes | Access token type. |
| `scope` | string | No |  |

**Errors:** 401 Invalid credentials · 403 Forbidden · 429 Too Many Requests
